text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Solarus is an open-source engine designed for creating and playing 2D action role-playing games inspired by classic adventure titles. Originally developed to recreate and expand upon the style of The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past, it provides tools for maps, quests, scripting, graphics, and gameplay systems. Solarus supports fan-made games and original projects while allowing developers to create complete adventure games using modern computers.
